name: commit-guard
description: Blocks a git commit or a pull request text that breaks a rule: an attribution line, an em-dash, an emoji, a version in the subject, or the wrong git identity.

gitName.title: Git name
gitName.description: The name that each commit must carry. Leave it empty to skip the check.

gitEmail.title: Git email
gitEmail.description: The email that each commit must carry. Leave it empty to skip the check.

attribution.title: Block attribution lines
attribution.description: Block a Co-Authored-By line or a footer that says a tool made the text.

emDash.title: Block em-dashes
emDash.description: Block an em-dash in a commit message or a pull request text.

emoji.title: Block emoji
emoji.description: Block an emoji in a commit message or a pull request text.

versionInSubject.title: Block a version in the subject
versionInSubject.description: Block a version number, such as v1.2.0, in the subject line.

conventional.title: Require Conventional Commits
conventional.description: Require a subject that starts with a type, such as feat: or fix(parser):.

prText.title: Check pull request text
prText.description: Apply the text rules to gh pr create, edit, comment and review.
